description: Tool registration and term set for King Wen evidence processing.
architecture_principle: Multi-destination routing with one canonical evidence record.

canonical_evidence_record.definition: The original source record. Carries provenance from producer to consumption.
canonical_evidence_record.semantic: Single identity, single provenance chain. Never duplicated.

classification_collection.definition: Multiple classifications with confidence and evidence, retained per canonical evidence record.
classification_collection.semantic: Retain all classifications. Rank by confidence. Do not discard alternatives.

routing_decision.definition: Zero or more destinations derived from classifications. Does not delete the canonical record.
routing_decision.semantic: Non-destructive. Records what was routed and why.

derived_dataset.definition: One output file per derived dataset type. Same evidence record appears in multiple derived datasets.
derived_dataset.semantic: Each dataset is a subset of canonical evidence, shaped by classification routing.

best_classification.definition: The highest-confidence classification. Used for selection, not sole routing criterion.
best_classification.semantic: Ranking aid, not exclusive routing token.

math_symbol_classifier.input: image region + OCR text + shape features

build_benchmark_representativeness.purpose: Multi-label benchmark attribution with attribution rule.

routing_orchestrator.purpose: Class-to-destination routing. Non-destructive. Reads canonical evidence + classifications, writes to multiple destinations.
routing_orchestrator.output: one or more derived dataset files
